context: A senior trains a new hire on submitting expense reports
purpose: Teach: 支払わ/勘定/代行/名目/提唱/容認/容器/同日

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 経費精算の件だけど、今日は研修の名目で僕が説明するから、しっかり覚えてね。
lines.en: About expense reports, today I'll explain under the pretext of training, so make sure you remember it.
lines.style: Patient mentor tone, slightly formal but warm guidance

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、よろしくお願いします。実は先月、自分で支払わなきゃいけない分まで会社に請求しそうになって…。
lines.en: Yes, thank you. Actually last month, I almost billed the company for amounts I should have paid myself.
lines.style: Nervous junior employee admitting a near-mistake honestly

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: あるあるだよ。領収書は専用の容器に入れて持ち歩いて、同日中にスキャンするのが鉄則ね。
lines.en: That happens. Carry receipts in a dedicated container, and scan them the same day — that's the iron rule.
lines.style: Practical senior sharing concrete workplace habits clearly

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 同日中ですか。あとで勘定が合わなくなると面倒ですもんね。
lines.en: Same day, got it. If the accounts don't match later, it becomes a hassle, right?
lines.style: Attentive trainee confirming understanding with light reasoning

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そう。それと、誰かの代行で立て替えた時は、依頼者の名前を備考欄に必ず書いてね。
lines.en: Right. And when you pay on someone's behalf, always write the requester's name in the notes column.
lines.style: Explaining concrete procedure with steady mentor delivery

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。タクシー代とかも代行で出すこと、ありそうですね。
lines.en: I see. There'll probably be times I pay for taxis on behalf of others too.
lines.style: Junior connecting the rule to realistic situations

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: うん。あと接待費は上限を超えると通らないから、事前に僕に相談してね。
lines.en: Yeah. And if entertainment expenses exceed the cap, they won't go through, so consult me first.
lines.style: Senior setting firm boundaries with approachable delivery

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 了解です。ちなみに、上限の見直しって誰かが提唱したりしてるんですか?
lines.en: Understood. By the way, has anyone been advocating for revising the cap?
lines.style: Curious junior asking thoughtfully about office policy

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 前の部長が一度提唱したけど、経理がなかなか容認してくれなくてね。今もそのままだよ。
lines.en: Our former director once advocated for it, but accounting wouldn't really accept the idea, so it's still as-is.
lines.style: Sharing institutional history with a knowing senior tone
